ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed distribution with low-intensity (black) pixels representing approximately 95% of the surface area and high-intensity (white) pixels localized at the distal tips and notch base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary low-intensity (black) contiguous area covering both lobes; discrete high-intensity (white) geometric blobs concentrated at the left distal tip, right distal tip, and a small cluster at the base of the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a deep bounding-box depth, forming an interior angle of approximately 40-45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Visible irregular serrations along the trailing edge; a significant pixel-amplitude drop-off (step feature) is present on the left lobe approximately one-quarter of the distance from the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge leading to tapered, upward-tilting distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white pixels located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, exhibiting irregular, roughly circular geometries.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized high-contrast white encrustations at both lobe tips; a distinct notch-like indentation is present on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
